intro: Football and running are popular in Somalia, and Somali-born athletes have shone abroad.

chapters.title: Athletes
text: Mo Farah, born in Somalia, won four Olympic golds for Britain. Abdi Bile won the 1,500 m world title for Somalia in 1987.

chapters.title: Football
text: Football is played in Mogadishu's rebuilt stadium.
